capabilities: Record a full screen, a single window or a drawn region
Mix microphone and system audio into one track
Record with the cursor shown or hidden
Save WebM files to a configurable vault folder and embed them at the cursor
Stop recording from a red status bar timer
disambiguation: Not a captioning or sorting tool; it records screens, windows and regions to WebM files.
extras: Desktop only (macOS, Windows, Linux; not mobile). System audio is not recorded on Linux. Recording without the cursor requires downloading a ~1 MB helper binary from the project's GitHub releases into the plugin's bin/ folder; nothing else is downloaded and recordings stay in the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record a screen or window and keep the video in the vault next to the note it documents.

relations.evidence: Install the BRAT plugin, run BRAT: Add a beta plugin for testing

summary: Desktop screen recorder that captures a screen, window or drawn region with mic and system audio and embeds the saved WebM in the current note.
